body: Distillation is common in LLM post-training, where on-policy knowledge distillation (OPKD) uses student-generated trajectories to prepare the student for downstream RL. At each state, the student matches a next-token distribution supplied by the teacher. As the rollout enters states the teacher would not visit, the teacher-student distribution gap can accumulate. In tool use, this gap becomes consequential because student-written calls execute before supervision and their observations shape later prefixes. Proposer-verifier generation addresses this drift by letting the teacher decide which student-proposed text is retained during generation. Existing formulations govern text but leave tool execution outside their scope. We propose Persistent Teacher Anchoring (PTA), a student-induced but teacher-committed rollout construction. PTA retains chunk-level verification and adds turn-level commitment, allowing a call to reach the environment only after the teacher has verified the entire turn. Treating verified chunks as atomic generation units, we introduce persistent lookahead, which fills idle rollout capacity by advancing future samples and carrying unfinished ones across student updates under the fixed verifier. Across Search-R1-style retrieval and DeepEyes-style perception RL, applying PTA before downstream RL improves macro best@4 by 2.5 and 2.8 points over OPKD under the same downstream RL budget, while lookahead improves throughput by 24%.
summaryZh: 本研究提出了一种名为Persistent Teacher Anchoring (PTA)的方法，用于改进基于LLM的工具使用智能体的知识蒸馏过程。在传统的在线策略知识蒸馏（OPKD）中，学生模型会生成轨迹并模仿教师的下一个token分布，但当学生进入教师未曾访问的状态时，分布差距会累积，尤其在工具使用场景下，学生执行的工具调用及其观察结果会影响后续前缀，导致问题加剧。PTA通过让教师在生成过程中对学生提出的文本块进行分块级验证，并对整个回合（turn）进行承诺，确保只有经过教师验证的文本块才能被保留。这种方法将验证后的文本块视为原子生成单元，并引入了持久前瞻机制，利用空闲的生成能力来推进未来样本并跨越学生更新传递未完成的样本。在检索和感知RL任务上的实验表明，PTA相比OPKD能显著提升下游RL的性能，同时前瞻机制提高了吞吐量。
